_comment: Known feature-E2E failures. Each entry: { case, gap, reason }. Shrink-only: a new failure fails CI, and an entry whose case now passes must be removed in the same change.

sales-invoice.reason: A bill with items from two groups (gold SALES + silver SLVSALE) fails with duplicate AC_DATA.LEDR_KEY: every per-group income leg gets the same leg type 03. Desktop posts one revenue leg per detail line keyed VCH_NO+STR(SR_NO)+'05' (Ac_Ledr.cs:74).

Lost update: two operators load the same voucher, the first saves, the stale second save answers 200 and overwrites it (line 70,000 instead of 65,000). editSale reads no version token; tracked by N51 (version tokens on every update/delete, waiting on decision D17).
Desktop saves with the &Save mnemonic, Alt+S (TR_SALE.cs:4896 BtnSave.Text = "&Save"). No web Save button sets accessKey, so the keyboard save path does not exist.
